page.layout: One page of running text. Short marginal notes are clipped at the right edge. Running head at top, page number top right. Gathering signature bottom left, catchword bottom right.

main_text.p: magistrum vocabant, ita Rhodum operibus munierunt, munitamque tantis animis defenderunt, ut ipsa inde à Saracenis, hinc à Turcis frequenter armis tentata multo tempore perstiterit invicta: Mahometem etiam Magnum, Turcarum imperatorem toti Christiano orbi terribilem, postquam is Con-stantinopolim, imperii orientalis Augustam sedem, expugnasset, Græciam totam occupasset, Trapezuntem quo-que cum altero imperatore cepisset, Eubœam cum Chalcide in potestatem redegisset, ac demum vires suas in Rhodum vertisset, singulari defenso-[illegible, ~4 letters]rum virtute rejectum, consumpto frustra[illegible, ~3 letters] omni ejus conatu, re infecta[illegible, ~3 letters] dignantem fremententemque insula di-dere[illegible, ~3 letters] coegerit an. Christ. MCCCCLXXVI.[?] Tandem autem à Solimanno Mahometis[?] pronepote, qui imperium Turcicum magnis accessionibus à patre auctum acceperat, diu summis viribus oppugnata, ab omnibus Christiani nominis principibus ac populis deserta, in potestatem ejus concessit anno æræ nostræ MDXXII jam jam exituro, die nimirum XXV Decembr. quem dicatum memoriæ nativitatis DOMINI Chri-stianus orbis magna festivitate celebrat. Militibus cum magistro suo & rebus

page.notes: Right margin: four clipped marginal notes, only fragments visible at the edge, so they are marked illegible. Reading "frustra", "MCCCCLXXVI" and "Mahometis" is uncertain because of overlapping marks. The word "di-dere" (discedere) is partly hidden by a note fragment. The stroke-through of the printed hyphens at line ends is not fully clear.
